content: The first step in utilizing such methods to categorize textual data is to convert the texts into a vector representation. One of the most popular text representation models is the bag-of-words model BIBREF0 , which represents each document in a collection as a vector in a vector space. Each dimension of the vectors represents a term (e.g., a word, a sequence of words), and its value encodes a weight, which can be how many times the term occurs in the document.
